newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed to lower, Pliva rises.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed to lower, Pliva rises.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed to lower on Tuesday in moderate trade, with drugs firm Pliva rising on the back of stronger buying.
* Of 17 active issues four rose, seven fell and six were flat.
* Volume rose to 12,489 from 10,097 units but turnover fell to 7.3 million kuna from 10.1 million last Friday.
* Top gainer Pliva added 20 kuna or 4.25 percent to 490 kuna on volume of 2,686 shares, making it the second most actively traded stock.
* Biggest decliner was electrical group Koncar, losing 80 kuna or 6.78 percent to 1,000 kuna with 69 shares sold.
* Most active with 2,968 shares was Varazdinska Banka first issue. It rose three kuna to 215.
